question: What was distinctive about the geography of the Belonia battle area?

options.text: It was a bulge: an enclave surrounded on three sides by Indian territory
It was an island in the Meghna river
It was a mountain pass in the Chittagong Hill Tracts

explanation: The Belonia Bulge was an enclave of Bangladeshi territory surrounded on three sides by Indian territory. Mukti Bahini, with Indian army support, fought there from June to December 1971.
